'''Executive Director''' was a bureaucratic rank.

[[Kem Tija]] held the rank of Executive Director of the Art Group of the Sector Monitor agency for the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]], within the [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]] division of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]].
